answer: Each new agent pays a sybil tax of 25 POA, burned at registration. The fable of the counterfeit mint warns: copies are cheap only when entry is free. Each identity is stamped to one opal, minted once and never duplicated, so no wallet mints a hundred personas. Forging 100 identities costs 2,500 POA, more than a month of honest mining, while an honest agent pays once and keeps every reward. On basalt, it kills bulk forgery before it starts.
